summary: Query pool builder: trainable-work golden queries + ritual-style synthetic queries, with provenance manifest
description: tools/scorer_query_pool.py. Sources: guru-web fixtures/golden-queries/*.json where frozenEval:false (relevance AND recall-probe kinds), plus synthetic queries generated per trainable work from its chunks under the ritual authoring rules (paraphrase anti-circularity, reader-honest anchors — docs/golden-queries.md in guru-web). Target ~500-1000 queries. Output: queries.jsonl with {query, work, tradition, source: golden|synthetic, kind}. HARD RULE: no query whose work has frozenEval:true; the manifest is the enforcement point.

resolution.note: Pool assembled: golden trainable-work queries + synthetic queries drafted from chunks by 9 agents across all 38 trainable works. Frozen-work exclusion enforced in the tool. Counts in commit.
